agent.reasons: The entity and all four owners (one of whom is also the control person) are located in Vietnam. Vietnam is on FATF's increased-monitoring list, so the case goes to EDD under 6.2. Everything else checks out: the control person is identified, the four owners add up to 100% and all are ID-verified, the registry filing (2026-02-19) is under 12 months old, sanctions, PEP and adverse-media results are all clear, the industry is normal, and no sanctioned country is involved. Escalation is the most severe outcome that applies, so it governs under 2.1.
still_needed: Confirm Vietnam is still on FATF's increased-monitoring list as of 2026-10-27. It was added in June 2023, but the case evidence doesn't include the current list.
Adverse-media search records for the entity and each person (search terms, date, sources reviewed), as required by 4.4.
